description:
# Executable test-only plan — SystemConfigLive remaining lines (2026-09-30)

Status: planning only; no tests, coverage, full suite, or code edits run. Target `lib/zaq_web/live/bo/system/system_config_live.ex` at supplied 95% baseline. This issue is scoped to the 31 supplied line numbers, NOT the previous/older line map in `zaq-5vh.3`; coordinate ownership with its existing implementation before editing. All permitted edits: `test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/system_config_live_test.exs` ONLY. No production, support, E2E, catalog dependency or doc edits; if the contract is broken, stop and request approval for a separately scoped fix. Action reuse: not applicable — tests only, no new/changed executable operation, Action, agent tool or workflow. Existing public BO events/NodeRouter and real CreateDocument path remain authoritative. E2E: existing behavior only, no new browser spec or human UX/UI gate; coordinator decides whether to run existing system_config E2E at final delivery per workflow; do not run it during planning.

Shared execution recipe: keep existing `use ZaqWeb.ConnCase, async: false`, authenticated `user_fixture`/`Accounts.change_password` and `init_test_session(user_id: ...)`, `setup :verify_on_exit!`, sandbox rollback, `channel_config_fixture`, `Record` and existing data-source-source-scope router setup. Use session `put_session(conn, :system_config_node_router_module, Zaq.NodeRouterMock)` for *specific* routed response variants; stub `dispatch/1` by `%Zaq.Event{}` action/destination/request, and fail on unexpected mutating actions; never replace router globally or blanket-accept unrecognized actions. Avoid sleeps/polls: `render_click/submit/change/hook` is the LiveView barrier; `assert_received` for forwarded events. If the DB/agent producer should return real data, use the real sandbox-backed context instead of manufacturing invalid persisted rows. External IO is forbidden; never put real secrets in tests. Catalog/ReqLLM registry or application env changes remain in serial tests: capture original value/presence, register on_exit restoration BEFORE mutation, restore `with_catalog/1` snapshot and registrations, and stop mounted LiveViews before restoring catalogs if needed. No SQL Sandbox shared-mode hack; normal ConnCase cleanup rolls back fixtures. Reuse existing helper implementations instead of creating fixtures/support files. Assertions below are about DOM, flash, persistence, and emitted events, not private socket assigns.

A. Web browsing picker. Extend the existing `describe "web browsing settings"` in the allowed file (existing tests around 310–503). For each router-controlled case use one or two `channel_config_fixture(provider: "google_drive")` values with explicit `:data_source_list_source_scopes` responses containing scope id/root filters and `:system_config_get_web_browsing_config` returning `System.get_web_browsing_config()`; default incidental mount actions may reuse the existing `build_stub_response/1` but match picker/list/create actions explicitly. Assert Channels dispatch is `:data_source_list_files` with provider/config/scope/parent and authenticated actor for real picker loads. No persisted config changes until submit.

A1 [232,233,236,237]. First persist a complete web-browsing destination through `System.save_web_browsing_config/1` with valid selected source/scope/folder and allowed_domains `zaq.ai` (use scope supplied in setup); mount tab and verify `#web-browsing-selected-folder`, five hidden `web_browsing[...]` fields. Click `button[phx-click='clear_web_browsing_folder']`; assert label `No folder selected`, every destination hidden field nil/empty, allowed-domains input still `zaq.ai`; assert persisted destination unchanged before save. Submit form and assert persisted five fields nil and allowed_domains retained. Ensure Skills config remains unchanged. Sandbox rollback.

A2 [249,1900]. Provide two distinct scopes/sources in deterministic order, persist selected second source when exercising 1900. Mount tab, open picker, assert list uses second configured scope rather than first. Switch using picker’s source selector (`render_click(view,"switch_source",%{"source"=>"source:"<>first.id})` if no selector exists for that state), assert root list now uses first source and selecting its folder produces first config/scope fields. Send forged `source:does-not-exist` while picker open; assert previous selected source/folder remains and no list request is emitted by this synchronous event. Use unique folder names to verify selection. Never inspect private assigns. Covered 1900 specifically only with a complete persisted configured source, not first-source fallback.

A3 [287,1928,1963]. Router returns `{:ok, []}` for available data sources and a valid empty web-browsing config; mount shows disabled Choose folder. Send named `open_web_browsing_folder_modal` directly (simulates stale client), verify picker opens without Channels list; send `confirm_web_browsing_folder` and assert exact `Choose a data source first`; then open nested New Folder and submit name `Captures` to assert exact `Could not create folder: no data source selected`, dialogs remain, no create dispatch. This registered-event path is reachable despite disabled DOM control. No fake socket state.

A4 [313,321]. With valid source and empty folder list open picker, click `show_new_folder_modal`, submit whitespace to display validation (1966), then send `close_modal`: new-folder input disappears, picker stays, error cleared on reopen. Send `close_modal` again after closing nested and assert picker closes; test explicit precedence of guarded clauses. Check no persisted config mutation.

A5 [1952]. With one source, return `{:error,:unavailable}` for opening picker list; assert exact `Could not load folders: :unavailable` and empty list. Then return `{:ok,%{records: [%Record{id: "folder-1", name: "Evidence", kind: :folder, path: "Evidence"}]}}` on an allowed same-source switch; assert Evidence appears and old error disappears, request has correct actor/provider/root. No sleep; two synchronous events.

A6 [1966]. With valid source, picker and nested dialog open, submit `%{"name"=>" \t "}`; assert `Folder name cannot be empty.`, dialog remains and Channels create is never called. Combine with A4 to avoid redundant setup.

A7 [1980,1981,1986]. Strengthen existing screenshot folder creation test (~446): navigate a child `Record` folder rather than creating at root; return root list containing child, child list empty; submit `Captures` in nested modal. On `:data_source_create_file` assert trimmed name, `kind: "folder"`, config id string, parent folder id/path and BO actor; return successful `%Record{}`. After successful create assert nested modal closes, picker remains, `modal_error` disappears, and a subsequent `:data_source_list_files` request targets *child id* (not root); assert rendered new folder appears if list result includes it. No saved setting until explicit Confirm and Save; optionally confirm and assert persisted destination through System. This proves parent-id calculation and refresh, not just create request. Sandbox rollback.

B. Provider/model metadata. Put controlled-catalog tests alongside existing `with_catalog` tests (~7333), reuse existing catalog restore helper. [1386] is statically unreachable from the LiveView’s public events: only private caller of `model_options/2` passes literal `"openai_codex"` (line 1464); Custom selection uses `model_options_for_credential_id/3`. Do not expose private function or alter production solely for coverage. [1392,1393,1465] are reached only if unsupported `:openai_codex` is visible (show_unsupported setting true, ReqLLM Codex unregistered, non-catalog-only Codex entry), and `ProviderModels.models("openai_codex")` has at least one tool-capable entry. Prior `zaq-5vh.3` attempt recorded EMPTY models in this runtime; first verify via a bounded in-test explicit precondition using available catalog fixtures without mocking ProviderModels. If real contract yields a nonempty list, mount AI Credentials and assert Codex option is present through public UI; to establish model order separately assert independently expected displayed options through LLM credential form if a credential-scoped list shares these models. If models remain empty, do NOT install synthetic dependency internals, skip, or claim branch success; mark these three lines environment/catalog-unreachable for current pinned runtime and request coordinator decision on dependency/catalog changes outside this test-only scope. Empty Enum.map/sort/any? may technically execute but proves no mapping or sorting behavior; note instrumentation hits separately from behavioral coverage.

[1405] is statically unreachable: `provider_model/2` is only called from `credential_model/3` after its own nil/empty model-id guard (1408), so no public event passes nil/empty to `provider_model/2`. Existing blank-model tests cover the earlier guard; no new test. [1448] controlled ZAQ Router provider: existing `controlled catalogs retain custom providers and can expose zaq_router` uses `with_catalog`; assert its catalog fixture includes `:zaq_router` as non-alias/non-catalog-only and ReqLLM provider lookup does NOT short-circuit; mount AI Credentials and assert enabled ZAQ Router and Custom options. If ReqLLM is registered for this id, unregister within captured/restored helper. Reject conditional/tautological assertions. Existing test currently asserts the option but should explicitly validate preconditions.

[1586,1594] previously deferred in `zaq-5vh.3` because synthetic global catalog fixtures failed in whole-file run. Revisit only within controlled `with_catalog/1` and serial module: construct one catalog-only provider and actual LLMDB models with `embeddings: true`, `embeddings: %{max_dimensions: 2048}`, and `embeddings: %{default_dimensions: 1024, max_dimensions: 4096}`; ensure first two IDs avoid embedding-name heuristic patterns, and an `embeddings: false` negative. Assert public catalog retains metadata before mount, then create no-secret provider credential and persist embedding selection to same provider with boolean model/dimension 768. Mount/unlock; assert boolean model visible and false model absent. Validate changing MODEL only to max-only while credential/provider remains the same; assert dimension input exactly 2048. Change to default+max and assert 1024 precedence. Assert validation did not persist changes. If controlled catalog cannot survive mounted provider lookup, halt, record exact precondition failure and defer to approved catalog/fixture repair outside this task; do not use test-only production seam.

C. Staged OAuth. Extend tests beside `stages a new optional OAuth policy...` (~2271) with identical public `new_ai_credential` then `save_ai_credential` payload (optional OAuth; use Codex behaviour to avoid external authorization), no real provider calls. For [1702,1720] submit invalid staged name (e.g. empty), metadata `%{"anything"=>"value"}` for map branch if needed versus `"not-json"` or missing metadata for non-map at 1720; normalize_params preserves malformed string, and `mark_oauth_setup_pending` replaces with map. With real `System.create_ai_provider_credential` changeset error (or precisely scoped Engine event error returning real Ecto changeset), assert form remains with name field error, no popup and no credential row created. Check actual changeset validation path before choosing payload: if invalid metadata alone rejects and line 1720 still runs, assert invalid metadata error; if it succeeds unexpectedly, do not create leaked permanent credential (sandbox rolls back) and report contract discrepancy. [1712] with valid staged OAuth, make ONLY `:connect_oauth_start_global_configuration` return `{:error,:unavailable}` through session NodeRouterMock while normal create/fetch/list Engine actions use real dispatcher for controlled sandbox DB, or use existing router fixture with exact action stubs. Assert AI row persisted with required policy/pending marker, modal closes, no popup, exact safe error flash from `ai_oauth_error(:unavailable)` (derive from existing UI error helper), never echo secrets. If interception of the router for mixed real calls is unsafe, return explicit valid real structures for read/create steps with exact dispatch patterns and no fabricated broken association; otherwise mark blocked. [1749] valid current System creation always produces integer `connect_credential_id` (canonical Connect association); fallback would require a malformed/non-contract create response. Treat as producer-contract-inaccessible; do not fabricate unassociated row merely for line hit. Record as exception and ask approval if a real legacy case is found.

D. Defensive result shapes/settings. [1847] `unwrap_ok!/1` only called in MCP endpoint fetch; valid Agent API returns `{:ok, endpoint}`, not raw endpoint, as previous issue documented. No raw-success router stub solely for numerical coverage: contract-inaccessible, request explicit change-of-contract approval if compatibility is desired. [1894,1912] in web-browsing describe: stub list-sources action `{:error,:unavailable}` then config getter `{:error,:corrupt}`; mount tab and assert `Could not load Web browsing settings...`, no form, no Channels call. Separate test with list failure and successful empty `%WebBrowsingConfig{}` asserts form visible, no source picker, retained allowlist; cover 1894 independently. [1917] catch-all config response means non-`{:ok,%WebBrowsingConfig{}}`/non-`{:error,_}` result; current Engine getter contract returns only those shapes. Do not force unexpected response merely to increment coverage; contract-inaccessible unless a real producer branch identified. [1900] covered by A2 persisted selection. [1928] A3; [1952] A5; [1963,1966] A3/A6; [1980,1981,1986] A7.

Line accountability (exact): 232/233/236/237=A1; 249=A2; 287=A3; 313/321=A4; 1386=unreachable private literal caller; 1392/1393/1465=B conditional on actual Codex catalog models, otherwise catalog-runtime blocker; 1405=unreachable earlier guard; 1448=B Router; 1586/1594=B embedding controlled catalog or fixture blocker; 1702/1720=C validation; 1712=C URL-builder error; 1749=contract-inaccessible association invariant; 1847=contract-inaccessible raw MCP success; 1894=D sources error; 1900=A2; 1912=D config error; 1917=contract-inaccessible malformed getter response; 1928=A3; 1952=A5; 1963=A3; 1966=A6; 1980/1981/1986=A7. No other target lines are silently excluded.

Implementation/validation handoff: before implementation inspect `git status --short`, relevant `zaq-5vh.3` work and tests, and reconcile owner overlap with parent. Write/reuse cases above in the sole allowed test file, verify line numbers against current source. Run isolated test selection first (`mix test test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/system_config_live_test.exs:<test_line>`), then `mix test test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/system_config_live_test.exs --seed 1` and `--seed 2` with logs via Context Mode. Do NOT run full suite or coverage during this planning task. Implementation issue validation: `mix q` via Context Mode (includes formatting; no separate mix format), isolated tests, self-review; parent coordinates any subsequent numerical coverage via lifecycle phase 6, fresh `mix coveralls.json` only at authorized post-review phase, and final `mix precommit` before final human approval. If producer contract/catalog obstacle persists, record exact commands/errors, no weakened assertions. Since only test-only existing behavior, do not author new E2E; existing E2E execution is coordinator's delivery decision under Phase 4's system-config trigger. Never persist actual secrets or change production semantics for coverage.

comments.text: Coordinator review complete: exclusive ownership test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/system_config_live_test.exs. zaq-5vh.3 predates this task (last update Sept 5); its existing tests are baseline, not another current implementation assignment. Git clean before workers. No overlap with current other two plans; independent root. Preserve documented contract exceptions and report runtime blockers without production changes. Supplied-line mode: no full coverage report; coordinator serializes Mix checks and final edited-tests-only coverage.

Validation update (2026-09-30): final allowed test file passes serial seeds 1 and 2 (each 1 property, 225 tests, 0 failures; exit 0). Initial run exposed test-stub allowlist gaps and fixture-contract issues; fixed only in system_config_live_test.exs, including signed Record.Provenance for create_document. Runtime ProviderModels.models("openai_codex") under normal loaded catalog returned 90 models; entries include tool-capable true (e.g. gpt-5.2-pro, gpt-5, gpt-4o), but controlled with_catalog setup unregisters ReqLLM openai_codex and ProviderModels.models then returned [], so model-options coverage cannot be demonstrated without violating the do-not-mock dependency-internals constraint. No planned test left failing; please decide whether catalog/dependency work is warranted. Scenario 11 is reachable through public validation: metadata="not-json" normalizes to a non-map string; apply_auth_mode enters its non-map else branch, then test confirms invalid staged OAuth remains unpersisted. No mix q/format/coverage/full suite/precommit run.
